title: Taman Zakat Supports Karhutla Volunteers and Daily Wage Earners in Palangka Raya
excerpt: Taman Zakat, through Relawan Nusantara, delivered 200 Pos Segar servings to karhutla (forest and land fire) volunteers and 50 food packages to workers in Palangka Raya.
seoTitle: Taman Zakat Aids Fire Volunteers in Palangka Raya - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: Taman Zakat, through Relawan Nusantara, delivered 200 Pos Segar servings to forest and land fire volunteers and 50 food packages to workers in Palangka Raya.
html:
Palangka Raya, 28 October 2026 — Haze from karhutla (forest and land fires) in the city of Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan, has become a challenge for people who have to be active outdoors. Amid these conditions, volunteers keep working to put out the fires, while daily workers keep striving to earn a living for their families.

Through Relawan Nusantara, Taman Zakat delivered support in the form of the Pos Segar (refreshment post) service for karhutla volunteers and 50 ready-to-eat meal packages for those working to earn a living.

Pos Segar for Volunteer Karhutla Firefighters

The volunteers involved in fighting the karhutla have to contend with heat, smoke exposure, and physically draining work. To support their needs while on duty, Pos Segar provided 200 servings of assistance in the form of fresh fruit, such as watermelon, bananas, and pears, as well as drinks and accompanying food, including isotonic drinks, vitamin C, and bread.

This assistance is expected to help meet the volunteers’ food and drink needs after their work in the field.

50 Food Packages for Daily Wage Earners in Palangka Raya

The impact of the karhutla is also felt by people whose income depends on daily outdoor activity. Online motorcycle taxi (ojol) drivers and field workers still have to work even though the air quality is poor, because their families’ needs do not stop.

Through the distribution of 50 ready-to-eat meal packages, assistance was given to ease their need for meals while showing care for people who keep striving to earn a living amid the haze.

Adian, one of the ojol drivers who received the assistance, expressed his gratitude for the attention given.

“Thank you to Relawan Nusantara and Taman Zakat for the food provided. In air conditions like these, we still have to work to meet our families’ needs. This assistance means a great deal to those of us who earn a living on the road every day,” said Adian.

Ara, an MDMC volunteer involved in the karhutla response, also expressed appreciation for the support for volunteers who continue to serve in difficult conditions.

A Collaboration between Taman Zakat and Relawan Nusantara

Fatwa Ze of Relawan Nusantara said that support for volunteers and for people who keep working is an important part of humanitarian action.

“When karhutla occur, our attention is often drawn to the fires and the affected communities. However, we must also not forget the volunteers and the people who keep striving amid the heat and smoke. Thank you to Taman Zakat for entrusting this mandate to Relawan Nusantara. May this assistance bring benefit to our brothers and sisters in Palangka Raya,” said Fatwa.

Through this collaboration, Taman Zakat and Relawan Nusantara hope the support provided can help ease the needs of volunteers and the community amid the impact of the karhutla. After all, a simple act of care can be a source of strength for those who keep striving in the field.

Luaskan Manfaat
